title: Typed configuration facade from env-registry
summary: Generate a foundation/config facade from env-registry and keep durable catalogs and storage-backend off the settings path.
hint_triggers: On post-#1441 placement, runtime KYBERION_* settings resolve through foundation/config → foundation/env ← secure-io registry reader. generate:env-registry emits types-only config.generated.ts. Do not invent a config domain or route settings through storage-backend. Prefer config.get/text/bool for registered names; keep MISSION_ID/SYSTEM_ROLE/HOME and dynamic keys on getRegisteredEnvText. ESLint forbids new process.env.KYBERION_* reads.
